description: Searches the US OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list for vessels by name or IMO number and returns matching vessel entries (sanctions programs, flag, vessel type, owner, gross tonnage, call sign, IMO, aliases), via the US Consolidated Screening List. Only the OFAC SDN list; not the UN, EU or UK lists, and an empty result is not a clearance. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

q.description: Vessel name (3+ characters) or IMO number (7 digits)
